edit.statement: A child has the same mitochondrial DNA haplogroup as its mother: if A is the mother of B and A has mitochondrial haplogroup H, then B has haplogroup H.
edit.subject: has_mt_haplogroup
edit.scope: Which mitochondrial haplogroups follow from a mother-child link.

direct.prompt: If a woman has a given mitochondrial DNA haplogroup, does her child have the same mitochondrial haplogroup?

cross_lingual.prompt: 塞西莉·内维尔是理查三世的母亲，她的线粒体DNA单倍群是J1c2c。能否由此推出理查三世的线粒体单倍群是J1c2c？
Cecily Neville fue la madre de Ricardo III, y Cecily Neville tenía el haplogrupo mitocondrial J1c2c. ¿Se deduce que Ricardo III tenía el haplogrupo mitocondrial J1c2c?

derived.prompt: Cecily Neville was the mother of Richard III, and Cecily Neville had mitochondrial haplogroup J1c2c. Does it follow that Richard III had mitochondrial haplogroup J1c2c?
bridge: Cecily Neville was the mother of Richard III, and Cecily Neville had mitochondrial haplogroup J1c2c.

derived.prompt: Cecily Neville was the mother of Anne of York, and Cecily Neville had mitochondrial haplogroup J1c2c. Does it follow that Anne of York had mitochondrial haplogroup J1c2c?
bridge: Cecily Neville was the mother of Anne of York, and Cecily Neville had mitochondrial haplogroup J1c2c.

unrelated_near.prompt: If a man has a given Y-chromosome haplogroup, does his biological son have the same Y-chromosome haplogroup?

unrelated_far.prompt: Is the relation 'is a neighbour of' symmetric?

notes: Real: mitochondrial DNA is inherited from the mother, so the haplogroup passes down the female line; Richard III's remains were identified through this route (King et al. 2014, Nature Communications; University of Leicester), haplogroup J1c2c. Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
